llama: Llama is wild or domesticated South American cud-chewing animal related to camels but smaller and lacking a hump.
llano: A llano is an extensive grassy and nearly treeless plain.
llano estacado: Llano Estacado is a large semiarid plateau forming the southern part of the Great Plains.
llb: LLB is a three-year law degree.
LLB means the same as Bachelor of Laws.
lld: LLD is an honorary law degree.
LLD means the same as Doctor of Laws.
llew llaw gyffes: Llew Llaw Gyffes is son of Gwydion and Arianrhod.
llewelyn powys: Llewelyn Powys is British writer of essays.
Llewelyn Powys means the same as Powys.
llm: LLM is an advanced law degree.
LLM means the same as Master of Laws.
lloyd: Lloyd is United States comic actor in silent films.
Lloyd means the same as Harold Lloyd or Harold Clayton Lloyd.
lloyd webber: Lloyd Webber is English composer of many successful musicals.
Lloyd Webber means the same as Andrew Lloyd Webber or Baron Lloyd Webber of Sydmonton.
llud: LLud is a Celtic warrior god.
llullaillaco: Llullaillaco is a mountain in the Andes on the border between Argentina and Chile.
llyr: Llyr is Celtic deity who was the father of Manawydan.
